section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1977
title: 15 ## Accidental Deaths by Age Group : The accidental deaths reported during 1977 have been further analysed according to age group of the victims. On the all-India level, the maximum number of accidental deaths occurred in the age group of 18—30 years which accounted for 33.3 per cent of the total accidental deaths followed by the age group 30 to 50 years which shared 28.9 per cent of the total accidental deaths. 22.9 per cent deaths occurred in the age group below 18 years and 14.9 per cent deaths were recorded in the age group above 50 years.
